reviews.text:
Finding the right trainer for Tundra was not something I took lightly. He’s a big, incredibly smart Husky/Shepherd mix who is very dog-reactive, and I needed someone who could understood the dog underneath all the scary barking, lunging & snarling.

That’s exactly what I found with Jonathan at Dognify.

One of the things that makes his approach so unique and special is his use of his own pack as part of the training process. These dogs are absolute SUPERSTARS. Each dog has a role, and Jonathan understands exactly which dog to use, when to use them, and what Tundra needed from each interaction. Watching his pack help teach Tundra learn how to exist around other dogs has been pretty incredible.

They aren’t simply dogs hanging out together. Jonathan is intentionally using stable, experienced dogs to help Tundra practice communication, boundaries, confidence, and appropriate social behavior in a way that a human simply cannot replicate.

For a dog like Tundra, that opportunity is invaluable and not something that’s easy to find.

What I also appreciate about Jonathan is that he doesn’t use a cookie-cutter training plan. He pays attention to body language, thresholds, environment, and what Tundra is communicating, then adjusts accordingly. I’ve learned a tremendous amount just from watching him work and having him explain the “why” behind what we’re doing.

Tundra is still a work in progress, and I actually think that’s important to say. This isn’t about magically “fixing” a reactive dog. It’s about giving him better experiences, building skills and confidence, and helping me understand how to support him better.

Jonathan and his pack have played a huge part in that.

I genuinely feel blessed that we happened to find something this unique right here in Philadelphia. Jonathan is knowledgeable, patient, realistic, and truly invested in the dogs he works with, and his pack deserves their own five-star review.

Tundra gives Jonathan five stars. ⭐️

His pack gets six. 🌟

I sought out the help of Jonathan and Dognify for my dog, Lincoln, who was very reactive towards other dogs and some people when I walked him. It was difficult to do a proper, longer walk with him, as he would often lunge and pull quite strongly, including every time we turned to head back to the house, which was affecting my shoulder and capacity to walk him. Walks were just stressful. Lincoln was also very barky with visitors and when he heard any noise outside of the house, which would be very disruptful for my meeting since I work from home.

Jonathan came in, did an initial assessment of him, and, within a few sessions, taught me how to behave on the walk in a way that provided Lincoln with a better sense of safety. This took away his feeling to chase other dogs and people away every time.

I learned that it was mostly I who had to make some changes, and Jonathan was very helpful at providing me that guidance. That made all the difference in the world. Now Lincoln’s even getting better in the house now. He’s not so easily triggered and I’m able to disengage him from that excessive barking a lot easier. I loved working with Jonathan and would recommend him for anybody that needs help with a reactive dog.

I wish I could give more than 5 stars. I can't recommend Jonathon enough. After a car accident, my dog became so fearful of being outside that he would not go on walks. Jonathon gave us the tools and confidence to help him overcome his fears. Today, we're happily taking walks around the neighborhood again—something I wasn't sure would be possible.

Jonathon also helped us work through separation anxiety and taught me so much about understanding my dog's behavior. I've never met someone who communicates so naturally with both dogs and people. His patience, knowledge, and genuine care made all the difference, and I'm incredibly grateful for everything he's done for us.

Amazing trainer. Had issues with my nervous and somewhat reactive staffy. She is golden now. Thorough work and activity plans are setup to give your dog a roadmap over the sessions. From group work with other dogs and new people in controlled environments. Trail and nature walks. Their was always something new being provided to further understand my dog. I'm so grateful and happy with our experience. I learned so much about my little one. All dogs can be a little different, and sometimes we need help. Don't hesitate to do the right thing for yours.

We originally hired Jonathan for my roommate's rescue pup, Hermane. During her first few months with us, she had a few bite incidents while she was still adjusting to her new home. Outside of our apartment, she's always been a bit timid around people, but calmly and sweetly interacted with anyone who wanted to say hello. However, having guests come into our home, was a completely different story. She was extremely fearful of unfamiliar people entering the apartment, and after those incidents we kept her behind a baby gate anytime people came over because she would bark, lunge at the gate, and become so worked up that we no longer felt it was safe for her to interact with guests freely. On top of that, she was so overwhelmed by the busy sights and sounds of the city that she'd often freeze in place, refuse to walk, and shake as soon as we stepped outside.

Jonathan's approach was exactly what Hermane needed. Rather than trying to force her through situations she wasn't ready for, he focused on building her confidence while giving us the tools to better understand her behavior, advocate for her, and set her up for success. To help with her fear of the busy city environment, he showed us how to gradually expose her to it at a pace that built her confidence. While she's still naturally cautious in new environments, she's now much more confident outside and is no longer the dog who would freeze and refuse to walk the moment we stepped out.

For guests in our home, Jonathan developed a structured introduction plan that included muzzle training, teaching us how to properly manage introductions, and coaching our guests on how to interact with her. He first worked with Hermane himself during in-home sessions before bringing different volunteers over to help us practice with new people. During our last few sessions, her muzzle was on for the first 10 minutes or so out of caution when someone new entered the apartment, but once she had the opportunity to warm up on her own terms and her space was respected, she was able to comfortably and safely interact with guests without it.

As an added bonus, I have my own dog, Nash, who is basically Hermane's complete opposite when it comes to meeting new people. He's a big, excitable goofball who gets VERY excited when guests come into the apartment. While Jonathan wasn't hired to work with him, Nash was present for all of the in-home sessions, and I ended up learning just as much about managing his excitement and teaching him better manners and boundaries around guests. We still have more practice and repetition to do with both pups, but it feels like we now have the proper tools and foundation to continue that progress on our own.

So, if you made it this far, I would absolutely recommend Dognify! We're very grateful for the progress he helped us make.

My dog Junebug is a super-high-energy cattle dog mix living in the city. I tried everything I could think of to tire her out before I found Dognify. She now joins pack runs on the Schuylkill River three days a week and these activities have been transformative for her.

She loves the runs and her fellow dogs, and she even gets excited when she sees her favorite runners. She comes home after the runs and immediately passes out for at least 7 hours.

The runs have not only helped her let out her boundless energy, her time with the pack has let her become a more confident dog overall. She was abandoned at a very young age and when I adopted her she was scared of everything. She wouldn't even make it five feet into a walk before something (a stranger, a bicycle, a leaf) spooked her and she'd skitter back inside. We managed to slowly work through a lot of her fear, but her progress really exploded once she met the Dognify pack.

She has only been running with them since March but in that time she has grown way more confident while meeting strangers and dogs out in public. She is less fearful of new situations, and I truly believe that she has watched the Dognify dogs and learned from them that the world is not as scary as she thought it was.

Jonathan was an amazing. As first time dog parents, it was very overwhelming to adapt Luna to city living. Jonathan taught us the basics to understand how our doggies mind works, which gave us the tools to give our doggy the relief she was looking for, which also improved our quality of life significantly! Thanks Dognify!! Highly recommended!!

Jonathan and everyone at Dognify were absolute marvels with our dog, Layla. They not only knew how to communicate and work with us, but work with and communicate directly with Layla - a whole cornerstone of Dognify's philosophy is getting on the dog's level of communication and understanding, and that showed in every step of Layla's training process. Jonathan especially was the first person that Layla truly felt comfortable with (outside of people directly in her household). They really know how to talk Layla's talk, and walk Layla's walk!
Johnathon and his team at Dognify are wonderful people to work with. My basenji Zinzan always looks forward to going on the pack runs and he also enjoys hanging out with the runners at the dog park.

Jonathan was so helpful with both my dogs and not only worked with my dogs but also with my family to understand what to do better! He is kind, passionate, and has a knack for the job. He helped with crate training, dog possessiveness, recall, and much more. Highly recommend !

Can’t recommend Jonathan enough. He is by far the best dog trainer I’ve worked with - it’s as if he speaks dog. He is able to quickly identify the sources of behaviors in dogs and come up with plans to address them. He also makes a point of educating the owners on everything he does, not only so they understand but so that they can build the right habits.

His expertise with dogs ranges from simple issues like basic manners all the way up to severe reactivity/aggression. He helped us with a dog that was so reactive, we couldn’t walk him in our neighborhood. Jonathan was able to work with him and walk him through some of the busiest parts of South Philly (broad street, Marconi plaza, Washington Ave, etc.).

If you go with Philadelphia Dog Academy you can feel confident you are getting the best dog training at an extremely fair rate.

Lucky to have worked with Jonathan -- I can say with measure that he changed our lives, especially that of our newer rescue N who had a lot of fear based aggression and was attacking our older rescue dog T.
Jonathan applied his depth of knowledge, calm character, & patience with humans, to help us figure out what each dog needed individually so we could set up an environment that worked for them both. We weren't sure we'd be able to keep N (who we were fostering at the time) but after implementing what we learned from Jonathan during session one, the relationship started to move away from what had been fraught/stressful towards something that developed into a bond. It's been almost three years with this hilarious pack of two.
I highly recommend Jonathan/Dognify, (and have in fact recommended him to friends many times). I never write reviews, but I believe in Jonathan and want people to know about his services.

We had heard about Jon from some friends of ours who spoke highly of him and their input was spot-on. We have a delightful, energetic, Bernese puppy… who was a bear to walk and also not always the best follower of instructions. Through Jon’s patience with Bento and with us, we’ve come a long way. Our puppy pulls far less, listens to me and is also has gotten much better about respecting personal space. He’s well on his way to being a model dog citizen and that’s in large part due to Jon’s excellent, patient teaching of both us and him. I would recommend him for training wholeheartedly - our experience has been fantastic.

When I adopted my Thai street dog, Twix, I reached out to Jonathan to support his transition into a completely new life and environment. From our first interaction, I've been impressed by his depth of knowledge, thoughtful approach to understanding both dogs and their people, and the genuine enthusiasm he brings to his work. He has provided invaluable guidance in understanding Twix's behavior and needs, helping me create an environment where he can thrive. His observations and recommendations are practical, insightful, and tailored to Twix, making our transition together much smoother.

In addition to behavioral sessions, Twix participates in Dognify's pack runs. He is always excited to see Jonathan at pickup and comes home happy, fulfilled, and ready for a well-earned nap. I love knowing he's not only getting great exercise but also opportunities to socialize with a variety of dogs before and after the runs at the dog park—something Twix absolutely loves. As a highly social and playful dog, those interactions are incredibly valuable.

I've also had the opportunity to meet other members of the Dognify team, including Faye, who has been wonderful. Everyone is friendly, professional, and clearly cares deeply about the dogs in their care, which is both reassuring and heartwarming.

Jonathan and the team are excellent communicators, consistently providing updates and making scheduling easy. I highly recommend Dognify to anyone looking for knowledgeable, compassionate, and trustworthy support for their dog. I'm incredibly grateful to have found them.

If you’re looking for someone who helps solve problems without immediately relying on e-collars, you’re in the right place. Jonathan is also not the kind of trainer who takes your dog away for a month and promises to “fix” them. (Honestly, who could trust that?) Instead, he teaches you how to understand and work with your own dog, creating results that actually last.

Our biggest challenge was having guests over, especially children. Loki would get extremely excited and was very difficult to manage. Having friends visit was always stressful, but one simple structured change completely transformed the situation. Kids are no more afraid of him!

I also no longer worry every time we see another dog, as Loki wasn’t friendly or comfortable around other dogs before. In fact, Loki now has a dog friend that I would have never introduced him to before working with Jonathan!

Life with Loki is so much less stressful and so much more enjoyable now. Thank you, Jonathan!
P.S. Loki is 6 y.o. , it’s never too late to for change !
Hi Kristi, thank you for the review. It has been such a pleasure witnessing Blue grow in confidence with you out in the streets. Keep up the good work!
I’ve had an amazing experience with Dognify! My dog’s behavior has improved remarkably, all thanks to their wonderful team. I couldn’t be happier with the results. Highly recommend!

I recommend 100%. They have a very innovative and effective technique, especially with dogs with difficulties. The owner understands dog’s needs, and helps you accompany your dog in the process towards maturity and integration.

We are so grateful that we hired Jonathan to train our energetic cockapoo puppy. Jonathan is incredibly knowledgeable about all things dog-related. After just a 30-minute evaluation, it felt as though he had known Stella for months. He quickly understood her personality and our specific pain points, which truly impressed us.

We were blown away by how thoughtfully he approached her training and by the comprehensive plan he created. Jonathan helped us improve Stella’s recall and better structure her daily schedule so she could channel her boundless energy in more productive ways. As a result, we not only live more harmoniously with her, but we also understand her much better.

Jonathan was also very flexible with our schedules, which we greatly appreciated. We are thankful for all of his guidance and support and would highly recommend him to anyone looking for a knowledgeable and thoughtful dog trainer.
Excellent service, Dognify has been awesome for our pup!

We are over the moon to be working with Jonathan for our American Bully, Crinkle! We rescued Crinkle a few years ago and through lack of interaction with other dogs he has grown to experience anxiety and reactivity to other dogs on walks. We did not know where to turn, especially with how large of a dog Crinkle is and we were worried someone wouldn't be able to pour their time into him. We found Jonathan with Dognify and are SO beyond happy with the process so far. Jonathan is extremely knowledgeable and has outlined a great process for us to go through with our dog to ensure he not only curbs his anxieties but that can become one with the pack!

We are so overjoyed with the process so far, especially with Jonathan's organization and thorough plan for Crinkle, recommendations on the best equipment for his trainings, and most importantly equipping both me and my husband with the confidence and tools to train our dog. We are also so pleased with the pricing! Training takes quite a few series of sessions depending on the situation and we are glad this is an extremely affordable and successful investment for us.

If you are looking for a true dog behaviorist in the city and for someone who will not only take the time and energy to solve the root of your dogs behavioral problems, but ensure you are ready to tackle them as owners -- look no further than Dognify! THIS is the solution for you and your own little pack!

We’ve been working with Jonathan at Dognify for the past four months to help our dog Baylor, who struggles with generalized anxiety, fearfulness, and separation anxiety. The progress we’ve seen has been truly encouraging. Jonathan is incredibly patient, not only with Baylor but also with us, guiding us through the training process with clear and supportive advice. While Baylor’s journey takes time, we can see him improving day by day thanks to Jonathan’s expertise and dedication. We’re very happy with the training process and grateful for the care and professionalism Jonathan brings to Baylor’s education.

Jonathan is a truly talented and dedicated dog trainer/boarder. I use him for boarding and my somewhat anxious dog now loves going to Jonathan's. He provides attentive care as if your pet was his own. My dog also goes on pack runs with Jonathan and it has markedly improved his confidence when we walk solo!

Jonathan is a gift to the Philly dog community.

Jonathan at Dognify has been such a gift for me and my rescue dog, Pepper. I first reached out for help with her leash reactivity and basic skills, and the progress since then has completely changed our day-to-day. Our walks are calmer, easier, and genuinely enjoyable, and the training has strengthened our bond in ways I didn’t expect. Pepper literally bounces around when we practice things we’ve learned with him.
I really appreciate how adaptable and thoughtful Jonathan is. Whenever Pepper's needs have shifted, he adjusts our training without hesitation and always finds ways to keep her engaged and confident. He's met my many many many questions as a first time dog owner with so much patience, knowledge, and kindness. He’s also helped me understand more about Pepper, like what kinds of activities she actually enjoys, what motivates her, and how to work with her personality specifically.
Working with him has given me confidence, given Pepper structure she genuinely loves, and made our life together so much easier and happier. I’m truly grateful for everything he’s done for us.

Meet Cashew, the 10th Doberman I’ve had in my life.  The breed is challenging due to their intelligence and need for mental and physical exercise. I purchased Cashew (the nut) when he was 14 months old from a highly reputable breeder, who should be commended for the quality of her dogs and their amazing temperament. Cashew (aka Cash) was born in February 2020, and turns out he is a true covid puppy.  He spent his formative years sprinting in and out of a doggie door in a fenced-in yard, with little socialization and rarely on a leash. For rational reasons, his first owner returned him when he was 14 months old, and I jumped at a chance to have a dog from this breeder, not really thinking about the huge change in lifestyle it would be for him to move to Center City Philly and have to be on a leash.

We needed to work through many issues with Cashew: walking on a leash, housebreaking because he never had a schedule, reactivity and EXTREME excitement upon seeing other dogs, cats, and squirrels.  Everyone in the neighborhood knew him because of his dramatic screaming, sounds of which I'd never heard before.  I’ve trained all my Dobermans before him, but Cashew’s anxiety only exacerbated my own whenever I had to open the front door to all the things that triggered him outside. I felt unqualified to take on his needs, but would never give him up as he became mama’s boy.

Then one day I saw Jonathan standing on the corner near my house with a pack of 5 large dogs and learned he was an urban dog trainer. Wow, this is just what we needed. And I was even more thrilled to learn that he uses positive reinforcement and works on behavior and not just obedience and didn't expect me to continue to try to train him considering my anxiety.  Jonathan is extremely knowledgeable about dog behavior and body language and brings the patience and calmness needed to the end of the leash. We can now walk Cashew on a loose leash. He doesn’t scream when he sees other dogs (although his noisy reputation may always stick with neighbors), and I no longer have to fear he will drag me down the street when he sees a squirrel.  This was accomplished through obedience training, and with mostly understanding a dog’s needs and working on calming his behavior.

Jonathan has filled a need that we could not, due to our age and lifestyle. We now have Cashew in a Dognify program where he gets picked up several days a week for morning jogs, pack walks through the city, and/or socializing at the dog park. Jonathan knows Cashew’s personality and behaviors and is fulfilling his needs in a way we could not do ourselves.  Would I recommend Dognify?  Absolutely!

I had three virtual sessions with Jonathan, and they were such a game-changer! He took the time to really get to know my dog, asking tons of thoughtful questions about his breed, habits, and quirks, before explaining what was going on. It turned out my pup was dealing with separation anxiety, and he broke it all down in a way that actually made sense.

Even though the sessions were virtual, they felt super personal. He gave me practical tips I could start using right away, and I’ve already noticed positive changes. If you want someone who truly cares and makes you feel supported while helping your dog, I can’t recommend Dognify enough!

We recently adopted a new puppy (Daisy) and wanted to get her some training from the start as she was found on the streets and you could tell she had little to no training in her life.  We posted to a local neighborhood group looking for a trainer and that’s how we found Jonathan and Dognify.

We were initially looking for basic command training, leash skills (pulling), and dealing with food excitement.  We reached out to Dognify and Jonathan was quick to reply and schedule time to meet Daisy.  Jonathan met us at a local park in South Philly for an initial meet and assessment of Daisy.  Jonathan provided initial thoughts and while she is a highly energetic and excitable pup, he did not have any initial concerns with Daisy which was great to hear.  We could tell right off the bat that Jonathan was very knowledge about dogs and dog behavior.

Jonathan was very honest and up front with us and noted that he specializes in training dogs with behavioral issues and past trauma, which Daisy did not seem to require.  While he could provide the training we were looking for, he admitted we could find trainers specific to our need for a cheaper cost and provided us local trainers information.  In our discussions with Jonathan we did note our hesitation with dog meets and dog parks with Daisy and she is extremely excitable around other dogs even when we are on walks.  Jonathan offered to schedule some dedicated dog park time with Daisy and his local Pack - we felt extremely comfortable with Jonathan and took him up on his offer.

Jonathan was able to quickly schedule the dog park training session the following day.  We met Jonathan and his pack of 5 dogs at a local dog park and the experience was extremely beneficial for Daisy and for us.  Once the pack got into the dog park and settled, Jonathan took Daisy to the vestibule for an initial meet with the other dogs through the fence.  Once the pack leader gave his approval, Jonathan led Daisy into the dog park leashed.  After the initial dog meeting, he was able to let Daisy off her leash.  Each dog in the pack truly met the description you can find on the website - the pack leader, the enforcer, the playful dog, etc.

We spent almost an hour in the dog park and got to watch Daisy interaction with each dog and learn about Jonathan talked us through different interactions and what he was seeing.  Again while Daisy is high energy, he was pleased with the interactions and the experience overall gave us more confidence in getting Daisy more interaction with other dogs.

We would highly recommend Dognify and Jonathan for any dog training needs - especially behavioral focused ones.  As new dog owners Jonathan gave us the knowledge and comfort we needed as we were entering this new world of dog owners.
I'm so happy with the service provided. My dog ​​responded very well 😃🐶

Jonathan has truly transformed my first dog, Douglas. As a former stray with a traumatic background, Douglas struggled with anxiety, resource guarding, and a strong prey drive. Thanks to Jonathan's patience and guidance, I've gained a deep understanding of Douglas’s body language and learned how to be an effective leader for him. The quality of life for both of us has significantly improved.

When the opportunity arose to rescue my second dog, Jonathan was instrumental in helping me integrate the young pup into our home. It has been incredible to witness Douglas's growth and how warmly he has welcomed his younger brother—an experience I once thought was impossible. Thank you, Jonathan! Your dedication to helping dogs adapt to city life has made a tremendous difference for us. I truly appreciate you! 🙏🏾
Hi Taci, it was great to work with you and Tiba. Wishing you all the best in your journeys!

Dignify and Jonathan have been transformative for our dog Patty and our family. We enlisted help for some behavioral issues with Patty and not only got a better behaved dog in the process but learned how to direct her energy and gained a skill to help her through any future issues. Jonathan is so knowledgeable, patient and kind and he is a pleasure to work with. We’ve also had Patty enrolled in weekly walks and runs and she has learned so much as a member of the Dognify pack!

It was amazing to have Amora and Nutella with Jonatan. His work is amazing and super structured, with many reports, tips and suggestions to work better with them at home. He helped me to understand better the dogs (and respect them) and my relationshipwith them, helping me to create a calmer and secure walk. He also helped me to note and understand their individual needs and accept that everything is a process, some days better than others (which helps with the feeling of frustration during training and day by day). My dogs love him and are really happy every time they see him.
Having Jonathan with us was an important and crucial part in our adaptation process with the dogs in another country and still helps us because having dogs is a continuous process of learning and adapting.

We had a wonderful experience with Johnathan. He is very knowledgeable and was very kind with my entire family in terms of getting even my youngest child to participate in the training. Highly recommend.

Working with Jonathan has been an amazing experience since day one! He is incredibly knowledgeable, patient with dogs and owners alike, and one of the kindest human beings out there. Jonathan helped my anxious dog overcome her fears of loud noises, and seeing her become more confident and more like herself (even in her senior years!) was a truly special experience that I'll forever remember and cherish in my heart. I cannot thank Jonathan enough for helping me trust my dog and for helping her have beautiful senior years surrounded by love and community. He is the best!!!

I met Jonathan through a friend of mine about 3 years ago, when I was looking for a trainer for my pitbull Rosie. Jon not only took the time to outline a plan with me, and help me execute it, but he became a close friend of mine and Rosie’s in the process. He’s a good man that you can trust; he cares deeply about dogs, and only wants to help clients achieve their dog goals. His rates are very reasonable, and he makes himself available to his clients. Appreciate you Jon!

Fantastic service, couldn't be happier!
We have two Great Danes: one we had as a puppy who was quite shy/insecure and the other who was a rescue that was completely the opposite - a lot of energy, hard to control on walks, etc.
Jonathan was able to work with them together and plenty of progress has been made. From day 1, he demonstrated exceptional knowledge and expertise, tailoring their approach to suit each of our dogs...he taught us as owners a lot along the way that was very helpful for time in the house and walks when Jonathan wasn't there. His service was reliable and it always felt like our needs and wants were being met above and beyond. Scheduling was easy as Jonathan was responsive and clear in communications.
I highly recommend Dognify to anyone looking to strengthen their bond with their dog and improve behavior. Thank you!!

Working with Jonathan has been fantastic and has made tremendous progress with my 5-year-old rescue, Remy. I highly recommend him for anyone who would like to better understand their dog and improve their behaviors.

I wish I started working with him sooner. I read the books, watched YouTube training videos, just about everything you could do to try and solve the problems yourself with minimal progress. After the behavior assessment and a couple of sessions he was able to solve a key issue that I couldn’t in over a year. His program has the framework that allowed Remy and I to continue to improve in several other areas like resource guarding, desensitization, socialization, and developing a routine better suited for his individual preferences. Not only has Remy’s behavior and our relationship significantly changed, I gained a much better understanding of how to communicate with him and we have built a much stronger bond.

Jonathan’s approach is detailed yet practical and I feel I am equipped and have the tools to continue supporting Remy. I cannot recommend Dognify (Jonathan) enough!

We cannot recommend Jonathan enough. He is incredibly knowledgeable and patient, and has a deep love for dogs. We appreciate how he was able to provide some insight for “why” behind certain behaviors, and not just “what” could be improved. After his baseline assessment, he provided clear instructions for each session and empowered us as owners to take the lead as we worked together. His goal truly was to provide a happy, fulfilling life for our dogs!  Thanks Jon!

Jonathan is an excellent dog trainer you can trust with your dog. He’s a true professional who took the time to listen to our needs and crafted a customized plan to address our high-energy Westie’s fearful behavior. More importantly, he taught us effective strategies to become better and more confident dog parents. The quality of our dog’s life (and ours) has vastly improved, making it a worthwhile investment.

Highly recommend hiring Jonathan for dog training. With only a few sessions I was able to socialize my very fear aggressive pitbull with other dogs, see her make friends, and have confidence responding in different situations. He is knowledgeable and professional, and helped many people in the neighborhood with an array of issues. Thank you Jonathan!!
Hi Caitlin, thank you for the rating. It has been nice to witness Frankie's progress. Let's keep up the good work.
Jonathon is amazing! He has such a calmness about him and has really helped Moose! He trains  him and teaches us what  to do about his behavior . We would be lost without him!

Jonathan helped me to understand and work with my Bloodhound, Lincoln. The breed is relentless when it comes to an interesting scent! He understood Lincoln’s nature, how to help him to to stay focused, sort out the distractions and stay on task. Jonathan also taught me and we continue to practice  what we have learned in our new neighborhood.

I can't recommend Jonathan enough! My two dogs, Oliver and Barkley, both had behavioral challenges that were making daily life stressful. Oliver struggled with lunging and biting at other dogs and people, despite being non-threatening. He was timid, shy outdoors, and easily startled by uncomfortable conditions and sudden noises. Barkley, the older of the two, had trouble with boundaries and listening to me, which added to the chaos.

Jonathan completely turned things around for us. His approach focused on teaching and enforcing boundaries, which not only addressed their specific issues but also strengthened my relationship with both dogs. Now, Oliver looks to me for guidance instead of reacting impulsively, and Barkley is much more respectful and responsive.

One of the most valuable aspects of the training was learning how to read a dog’s body language. Jonathan taught me to recognize subtle cues and understand what both Oliver and Barkley were trying to communicate in various situations. This knowledge has been a game-changer in managing their triggers and building their confidence.

What truly set Jonathan apart was his tailored and organized method. Every session was customized to address my specific concerns for each dog, and the knowledge transfer sessions gave me the tools I needed to reinforce training at home. We even practiced in real-world scenarios, which made the lessons immediately applicable.

The professionalism was top-notch—everything was organized through Notion with a clear breakdown of each session. Scheduling was always a breeze, and Jonathan was incredibly punctual and easy to work with.

Thanks to Jonathan, my dogs and I now enjoy our time outdoors together, and I feel confident in managing their behavior. If you’re looking for a dog trainer who truly listens, personalizes their approach, and delivers real results, look no further!
Jonathan offered valuable insight and practical strategies to help my dog feel more confident and comfortable.

Jonathan is a great dog trainer, knows exactly what he‘s doing and explains it carefully to you. He’s very patient with my westie Fiona and after a few sessions we could see changes in her behavior. He was approachable and answered all …

Jonathan is amazing!! He worked tirelessly with me and Jasmine, my anxious medical alert dog. He helped me and my husband to understand her needs so she can function fully and provide medical alerts. She recently had a successful 8-day trip …

Sometimes you need a behaviorist, not a trainer.  We had an issue with our ~8 month old puppy; there was one activity where he exhibited wild behavior. We learned that instead of addressing that specific activity, we had to address other …

Jonathan is a terrific trainer, he helped my dog and I prepare for his first flight as a service dog. His patience and ability with both dogs and their humans to adjust behavior shine through in all interactions. I have recommended him to my friends w. pups and will continue to do so confidently.

Working with Jonathan has completely changed my experience as a dog owner, my relationship with my dog, and my dog's confidence in the world! I adopted a Pomeranian mix a few years ago who has a fearful personality. …
